channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: A young Essex couple need Nicki Chapman's help to find them a new home in lovely Somerset, and fast. They have ?725,000 to spend on a property for their growing family, preferably one that has some income potential. Nicki also visits a local farm to sample some homemade specialities produced from its crop of an ancient grain, spelt.
